jokes.title: Парковка
jokes.gist: A late driver promises God to quit drinking and go to church if he gets a parking spot, and when one appears he tells God never mind, he found it himself.

firstLine.text: Мужик едет на встречу, опаздывает, нервничает,

jokes.title: Толкнуть
jokes.gist: A husband refuses a drunk asking for a push at 3 a.m., is shamed by his wife into going out, and in the dark the drunk calls that he is over on the swings.

firstLine.text: Три часа ночи. Муж с женой спят.

jokes.title: Сдача
jokes.gist: A customer makes a bartender walk to both ends of the bar for his dollars every day; when the bartender takes revenge by spreading out his change, the customer simply uses one coin to order another drink.

firstLine.text: Мужик заходит в бар, заказывает виски:

jokes.title: Курица
jokes.gist: A butcher fakes a heavier weight for his only chicken by pressing the scale, and the customer then asks to buy both chickens.

residents.name: Вася
residents.traits: simple and sly everyman, fond of a drink, always has an excuse
gags: comes home late with a story

residents.name: Люся
residents.traits: sharp-tongued, runs the household, wins every argument

residents.name: Вовочка
residents.traits: cheeky schoolboy who asks the wrong question at the right time

residents.name: Тёма
residents.traits: the youngest; says nothing, sees everything

residents.name: Зинаида Петровна
residents.traits: the mother-in-law: visits too often, knows best

residents.name: Барсик
residents.traits: the family cat; lazy, smug, judges everyone

residents.name: Коля
residents.traits: the neighbour across the landing: chatty bachelor who gives marriage advice

residents.name: Катя
residents.traits: the little daughter, Vovochka's younger sister: polite, curious, repeats what grown-ups say

residents.name: Костя

residents.traits: young nurse; kind, quick, unimpressed by flirting

residents.traits: the bartender: has heard every story, ironic, pours on credit
gags: keeps a tab for half the town

residents.name: Доктор Семёнов
residents.traits: the doctor: dry, tired, has seen everything

residents.name: Дед Матвей
residents.traits: Vasya's father: old, crafty, remembers how it used to be
gags: fishing stories that grow every time

residents.name: Рыжий Фёдор
residents.traits: the farmer: loud, practical, drives everything with wheels

residents.name: Бурёнка
residents.traits: the farm cow

residents.name: Чернушка
residents.traits: the other farm cow

residents.name: Зорька
residents.traits: the farm horse, wiser than the farmer

jokes.title: Песня по заявке
jokes.gist: A girl calls a radio station to say she found a wallet full of cash and the owner's business card with his address, and asks them to play him a nice song instead of returning it.

firstLine.text: Звонит герла на радио и говорит:

lastLine.text: Поставьте ему, пожалуйста, какую-нибудь хорошую песню!

jokes.title: Сходить
jokes.gist: Glamorous city girl visiting her village grandma asks where one can go at night, and grandma answers the toilet sense: in the bucket.

firstLine.text: Гламурная москвичка приезжает погостить в деревню к бабушке.

jokes.title: Чей телефон?
jokes.gist: In a sauna a rich man takes repeated calls from a woman asking to buy ever pricier things and agrees to everything, then asks his friends whose phone it is.

firstLine.text: Сидят несколько новых русских в бане.

jokes.title: Штраф
jokes.gist: Fined for insulting an official, the defendant says he'd like to add more but at these prices he can't afford it.

firstLine.text: Я приговариваю вас к пятистам рублям денежного штрафа за оскорбление государственного служащего.

lastLine.text: Вообще-то хотел бы! Но при таких ценах...
